title: tools.list annotations for wave-1 primitives
description: Hints for tools/list — not executable code. readOnly/destructive per MCP ToolAnnotations.

tools.name: snapshot_open
tools.description: Mint snapshot_id bound to tree_sha and index_sha. Call before resolve or claim_withdraw.

tools.name: locks_list
tools.description: List lock ids from git System of Record; returns lock_set_id handle.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run LockCheck; harness writes proof-carrying receipt. Model must not invent pass.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Resolve one injection site against snapshot. Returns resolved | unknown | unprovable.

tools.name: claim_withdraw
tools.description: Recompute claim dispositions for snapshot; unprovable allowed without destroying artifacts.
